rationale: Genome-wide GeCKO v2 knockout screens (Cimmino/Pérez-Riba lab, Commun Biol 2024) in MCF-7: after selection, cells were split into 2D culture and 3D tumourspheres for 3-4 weeks; one library each for T0, 2D and 3D, column names match the GSM titles. The paper's selection is the MAGeCK-MLE 3D-2D beta difference (both arms vs T0); BARCS tests 3D vs 2D directly, the same log-ratio contrast. Depletion in 3D marks genes and miRNAs needed for tumoursphere growth (hsa-mir-4787); enrichment marks suppressors (ARHGAP17, FOXO3, PDCD4). One library per arm, so run_barcs.R uses the no-replicate path and the calls are screening-level. A second analysis, 2D vs T0, checks that the screen selected (core-essential dropout).
